result: Scope clarification did not increase ReasonProxy deliberation uptake in these replays.
interpretation: Original 0/12 versus clarified 0/12 invocation-positive requests. Neither model invoked the proxy in either early or late state.
This tests the proposed scope-clarification intervention, not native model reasoning. The intervention did not restore uptake, so it is not promoted to production.
The result weakens the proposed explanation but does not prove the Bash mandate is irrelevant: a different intervention or trajectory could behave differently.
Only one task, two recorded model trajectories, early/late states, and repeated sampling were examined. Repetitions are not independent benchmark tasks.
No outward actions were executed and no task rewards were measured; no performance gain can be claimed.
